```{r}

ig <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@graphs$sNN_pca.SCT_30,
                                          mode = "undirected",
                                          weighted = TRUE)

sample_name_diffusion <- sccore::propagateLabelsDiffusion(
  ig,
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$sample.name,
  max.iters = 100,
  diffusion.fading = 10,# lower values increases the smoothing
  diffusion.fading.const = 0.1,
  tol = 0.025,
  verbose = TRUE,
  fixed.initial.labels = FALSE
  
)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,sample_name_diffusion)

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c( "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+") ,reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()

```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$Hif1a_detection <- ifelse(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data["Hif1a",]>2, 
                                            "Hif1a_on",
                                            "Hif1a_off")
Hif1a_detection_diffusion <- sccore::propagateLabelsDiffusion(
  ig,
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$Hif1a_detection,
  max.iters = 100,
  diffusion.fading = 1,
  diffusion.fading.const = 0.1,
  tol = 0.025,
  verbose = TRUE,
  fixed.initial.labels = FALSE
  
)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,Hif1a_detection_diffusion)

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c( "Hif1a_on") ,reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T,split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma")&RestoreLegend()
```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$Glis1_detection <- ifelse(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data["Glis1",]>1,

  verbose = TRUE,
  fixed.initial.labels = FALSE
  
)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,glis_on_diffusion)

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c( "Glis1_on") ,reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T,split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma")&RestoreLegend()
```

```{r smooth_count_matrix}
ig <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@graphs$sNN_pca.SCT_30,
                                          mode = "undirected",
                                          weighted = TRUE)

Glis1_smooth <- sccore::smoothSignalOnGraph(signal = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data["Glis1",],
                            graph = ig,
                            filter = sccore::heatFilter,
                            order = 3,
                            m = 50)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$Glis1_smooth <- Glis1_smooth

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            c( "Glis1_smooth") ,
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            pt.size = 0.1,
            order = T,
            split.by = "sample.name")&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", limit = c(0,0.1))&RestoreLegend()

```

```{r}
plt4 <- DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                label = FALSE, split.by = "sample.name",
                cells.highlight = colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)[mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$Glis1_detection=="Glis1_on"],sizes.highlight = 1)&
  NoLegend()

plt1 <- FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c( "Glis1_on") ,
                    reduction = "umap.nn",
                    pt.size = 0.1, 
                    order = T,
                    split.by = "sample.name")&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma")&

plt2 <- FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c( "Glis1_smooth") ,

                    pt.size = 0.1,

                   reduction = "umap.nn",
                   pt.size = 0.1, order = T,split.by = "sample.name")&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma")&
  RestoreLegend()

plt4/plt1/plt2/plt3
```

```{r}
hypoxia_gs <- list(HALLMARK_HYPOXIA = msig_gs$Hallmark$HALLMARK_HYPOXIA,
                   BUFFA_HYPOXIA_METAGENE = msig_gs$C2_all$BUFFA_HYPOXIA_METAGENE,
                   HARRIS_HYPOXIA = msig_gs$C2_all$HARRIS_HYPOXIA,
                  BIOCARTA_P53HYPOXIA_PATHWAY =  msig_gs$C2_all$BIOCARTA_P53HYPOXIA_PATHWAY,
                  gross_hypoxia_via_hif1a_up = msig_gs$C2$GROSS_HIF1A_TARGETS_UP,
                  gross_hypoxia_via_hif1a_up = msig_gs$C2$GROSS_HIF1A_TARGETS_DN
                   )
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddModuleScore(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,hypoxia_gs)


FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,paste0("Cluster",1:6) ,reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T,split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()

```
